settings.content: One bra chart per country, each in its own tab above Band Size + Cup Size. A tab shows only when its chart is filled; one filled chart = no tabs. Filled charts replace "Chart" below for the bra finder (not with Finder type = Weight + measurements). Same shape in every tab (same number of bands and cups) → the result lists every country, e.g. "EU 85C · US 38C · UK 38C", and switching tabs keeps the band and cup picked.

settings.info: Tab 1 is open first.

settings.label: Tab 1: chart
settings.info: First line = a name (e.g. EU) | the band sizes: EU | 75 | 80 | 85 …; then one line per cup with the size for each band: CUP A | S | S | M … ("CUP " is dropped in the picker). Cells split by |. More lines of band numbers right under the first (US/UK | 34 | 36 …) show as extra header rows. Empty = no tab.

settings.label: Tab 2: chart
settings.info: As tab 1, e.g. US | 34 | 36 | 38 … then CUP A | S | S | M …

settings.label: Tab 3: chart
settings.info: As tab 1.

settings.label: Chart
settings.info: First line = column names, then one size per line; cells split by |. Columns named Weight (lbs), Bust / Waist / Hip (in) drive the finder; any other column (e.g. US) is shown as typed. cm / kg converts them. Bra: first line = SIZE CUP | 34 | 36 … (bands), then one cup per line with the size of each band, e.g. C | M | L | L | XL.
